method_note: DyCoSS is dormant (last edition: 4th, Changsha, 21-23 May 2018); no session-level program was found, so papers were counted from the table of contents of the proceedings (AAS Advances in the Astronautical Sciences vol. 165, Univelt; contents PDF retrieved from the Internet Archive because univelt.com returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-16). 181 published papers (codes IAA-AAS-DyCoSS4-X-Y) in 8 topical sections; the foreword states 194 accepted papers in 15 parallel sessions (185 presented), grouped into these 8 topics. Weight = share of papers, 50/50 split for two-keyword sections. deployable-structures added 2026-10-16: searched all 181 paper titles (and abstracts) in the vol. 165 contents PDF. Two papers are about deployable structures: DyCoSS4-3-31 (deployable membrane primary mirror mechanism; was spacecraft-gnc, -1/181) and DyCoSS4-7-2 (deployable CubeSat solar panels; was split 50/50 spacecraft-gnc/mechatronics, -0.5/181 each). Result: deployable-structures 2/181 = 0.011, spacecraft-gnc 0.453 -> 0.445, mechatronics 0.064 -> 0.061. The 6 'Space Structures and Tethers' papers are all about tethers and debris capture, so structures was unchanged. Not counted: DyCoSS4-3-25 (variable geometry truss, treated as a manipulator for compliance control) and the two solar-sail trajectory papers (trajectory topics).
